subtests.name: onfocusreset event handler IDL attribute on Document
onfocusreset is only defined on Document
Removing the focused element fires focusreset at the document
onfocusreset event handler is invoked, with focus reset to the viewport
Removing the focused element doesn't fire blur/focusout, only focusreset
Trying to focus the removed element while disconnected doesn't cancel focusreset
Removing an unfocused element doesn't fire focusreset
Removing a previously focused element doesn't fire focusreset
Removing an element that was blurred before removal doesn't fire focusreset
